purpose: Eight scenery-only battle backgrounds matching the cel-shaded roster

arenas.name: Sunstone Colosseum
arenas.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: full-screen scenery-only battle background for a turn-based fantasy game.
Input images: IMAGE 1 is the existing arena to redraw, preserving its location identity, landmarks and spacious battle-camera composition. IMAGE 2 is the approved character ART STYLE reference only: use its bold, angular cel-shaded visual language for the environment; do not include the character itself.
Primary request: Completely redraw IMAGE 1 as a polished stylized 2D animation/game background matching bold cel-shaded action characters. A substantial style transformation: large simplified graphic shapes, selective clean contour lines, rich controlled local colors, two or three clear hard-edged shadow tones, smooth nonpixelated edges. Simplify repeated architecture, foliage and textures greatly. Ground is calm with broad color shapes and a few paving lines or sand contours only. Distant scenery has softer contrast and lighter outlines than the characters so overlaid fighters stand out.
Composition: ONE wide 16:9 landscape background, full bleed. Gentle slightly elevated fixed battle view. Broad level uninterrupted fighting surface covers lower 50–55%. Horizon near 45% from top. Leave near fighter position x30%, feet y78% and far fighter position x64%, feet y64% completely free of objects. Keep key landmarks in upper middle distance. Keep upper corners and right edge calm enough for HUD and move buttons; no large foreground branches, rocks or pillars obstructing fighter positions. Ground should have mid-value colors and visible depth, not a blank void.
Avoid: photorealism, granular realistic surface texture, detailed tiny leaves, tiny stone chips, microdetail, 3D renders, pixel art, gritty brush texture, overly thick black background outlines, characters, silhouettes of people, creatures, crowds, UI, labels, text, numbers, frames, watermarks. The result is ONLY the arena scenery. Background fully opaque; no transparency.
Preserve scene: A grand ancient sandstone colosseum enclosing a wide pale golden sand floor. Three tiers of elegant weathered arcades, sunlit columns, sparse ivy on upper masonry, open pale blue sky and a few soft clouds. A central arched gate sits in the far wall; empty terraces, no audience. Warm late-afternoon sunlight with balanced soft shadows. The arena foreground is calm open sand with subtle scuff texture. Golden sandstone, dusty ochre, light sky blue.

arenas.name: Mistwater Citadel
arenas.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: scenery-only game battle arena background, wide 16:9.
Edit target: the referenced Mistwater Citadel arena. Preserve the recognizable ivory castle with blue spires, blue mountain valley, waterfalls, clouds, atmospheric mist, cool blue-green palette and crisp bold cel-shaded illustration style. Change the battle ground and viewpoint so two fighters can stand naturally on a DRY ROCKY CLIFF ABOVE THE LAKE, rather than on water.
Composition: camera stands on a broad, level, elevated pale grey rocky terrace. This single continuous dry terrace occupies the entire lower 50–55% of the image and spans left to right. Its far edge is behind the future fighters, around the middle height of the image, overlooking the lake. A clear exposed vertical cliff face and falling waterfall visible at a far side establish that the water lies far below. Beyond the terrace, a strip of blue lake lies visibly lower in the valley; the castle is on the opposite rocky promontory in the upper middle distance. Keep the castle and its spires fully in frame.
The arena floor must be broad, flat, matte dry rock with subtle large stone seams, gentle perspective and daylight shadows, suitable for a turn-based battle. Completely clear unobstructed floor around x25–45% and x55–80%, y65–90%. No water, puddles, transparent water overlay, blue caustics or wet reflections anywhere on the fighting floor. Do not put a ravine, pit, drop or separate stepping platforms between the fighters. Cliff edges are only BEHIND the fighting area or at the extreme sides. No big rocks under their feet. Foreground shallow cracks and grass only at extreme corners. Match the reference's landscape aspect ratio and restrained scenery contrast so foreground character sprites will read clearly.
No characters, creatures, people, UI, labels, text, frame, watermark or pixel art. Opaque background. Only change the arena scenery as requested; do not include the screenshot's sprites.
